question: In which city was the 23rd National Conference on e-Governance held?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mumbai.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The 23rd National Conference on e-Governance was held in **Mumbai**.
 
• This conference is a significant event that brings together experts, policymakers, and other stakeholders to discuss and promote e-Governance initiatives in India.
 
• The conference aims to provide a platform for sharing knowledge and best practices in the field of e-Governance.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The National Conference on e-Governance is organized annually by the Department of Administrative Reforms and Public Grievances (DARPG) in partnership with the Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology (MeitY).
 
• It serves as a platform to showcase successful e-Governance initiatives and applications developed by various government departments and agencies.
 
• The conference typically features discussions on various themes related to e-Governance, including digital transformation, cybersecurity, and citizen-centric services.
 
• Participants include senior government officials, industry leaders, academia, and representatives from international organizations.
